name: Tsundere
tagline: Prickly on the outside, soft as a marshmallow underneath.

name: Yandere
tagline: Sweet, devoted, and maybe just a little too all-in.

name: Kuudere
tagline: Calm, cool, collected, and secretly paying attention to everything.

name: Dandere
tagline: Quiet at first, then the sweetest person in the room.

name: Deredere
tagline: Pure sunshine with a heart on both sleeves.

name: Himedere
tagline: Royalty in love. Treat them like a princess (or prince) and watch them melt.

name: Kamidere
tagline: A self-declared god of love who might let you be their chosen one.

name: Bakadere
tagline: Lovable chaos. Trips over their own feet and right into your heart.

name: Undere
tagline: Says yes to everything, especially to the one they love.

name: Mayadere
tagline: Dangerous, mysterious, and unexpectedly soft for one person only.

name: Sadodere
tagline: Teases you mercilessly because you are their favorite person.

name: Hajidere
tagline: Turns bright red the second their crush says hello.
